text:
liam (eng): hi team, first week q: I set up a Datadog monitor and tied it to #infra-alerts, but when I trigger the test it doesn't show up. I can see the monitor in my account. any ideas?
jess (observability): did you add the notification channel? monitors need a team channel or an email/webhook. go to Monitor -> Edit -> Notifications. if channel is #infra-alerts it needs to be configured in Datadog integrations.
liam (eng): the monitor notification field shows 'channel: #infra-alerts' and a slack handle @infra-alerts. not sure where to configure that in Datadog vs Slack.
sam (devex): we use the Datadog Slack integration configured by infra. try running the "Send test notification" from the monitor and check Datadog -> Integrations -> Slack -> 'Post to channel' permission. Also confirm your account has 'monitors' edit role.
liam (eng): where's the role request form? I have full access to metrics but maybe not monitors.
access-bot: To request Datadog monitor edit permissions, file an access request: https://redwood.company/internal/access-requests -> 'Datadog - Monitor Edit'. Include your username and desired expiration.
jess (observability): Also for Sentry: if you want to subscribe to issue alerts, make sure you're a member of the project team (Settings -> Teams -> add). If you can't see 'Alerts' tab, request 'sentry-project-read' or 'sentry-project-write'.
liam (eng): small extra: I duplicated a Grafana dashboard using the UI but grafana said "Insufficient permissions to save". Is there a quick workaround?
sam (devex): Duplicate -> Save As requires 'dashboard create' permission in that folder. Workaround: export JSON model and import into a folder you own, or ask infra to add you to the 'dash-editors' group for that folder.
jess (observability): export method:
```
Dashboard -> Share -> Export -> Save JSON
Grafana -> + -> Import -> Upload JSON -> choose folder
```
liam (eng): thanks all — filed Datadog monitor request (ID #4532) and infra already queued Grafana edit group add. will update when alerts arrive.
oncall-bot: Datadog monitor request #4532 created. ETA 1 business day. If urgent, ping @ben-oncall.
liam (eng): appreciated :pray:
